process: docs/baseline/DBF-1/DCR_PROCESS.md (a DCR is approved and committed before any rerun that uses the changed value; this file is the request; the register entry is made in a new register version by the register owner)
register_note: the DCR register (dcr_register_v2+) is maintained by the coordinator only (coordinator decision); DCR-DBF1-002 is registered there as OPEN_EVALUATION; this lane does not create or edit any dcr_register_v*.json

new_value.evidence_class: FE-DERIVED (scikit-fem 10.0.2 axisymmetric nonlinear magnetostatics, FEMM-class per A9.14 F5-OQ-01); NOT measured; NOT FEMM

quantitative: the DBF1-BZ-04 surrogate is a P5 shape: its anode-to-peak ratio 0.201, gradient and high-field width are P5 properties (DBF1-BZ-04 uncertainty); under the envelope prereg bz_family classification_effect a Hall non-closure under it is never eligible (NOT_DETERMINABLE, blocker H1_BZ_NOT_REGISTERED)

the FE-derived H-1 field of the registered MC-1 circuit (outcome FE_DERIVED_VERIFIED) differs from it: at BP-HI the FE anode-to-peak ratio is -0.000720131 (surrogate 0.201035), FWHM 36.792 mm (surrogate 43.8337 mm), peak at z - L = -4.50215 mm (surrogate 0 by registration); max normalised profile difference over z = 0 .. L + 66 mm 0.381644 (MATERIALLY_DIFFERENT)
physical_or_evidence_reason.never_the_reason: Hall / M2 performance: no Hall simulation was run with the FE field and none is used; the proposal follows from the evidence class (prereg v4 dcr_002_evaluation.method), whether the FE shape is favourable or not

evaluation_method.rule: propose iff the field outcome is FE_DERIVED_VERIFIED

results_seen_before_request.what: M2 closure record v1 summary: NOT_DETERMINABLE at C1, HALL_NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED on all required cells (no Hall value entered)

impact.DBF-1: DBF1-BZ-04 value and evidence class change; DBF1-BD-05 closes on approval (a measured map stays an EM verification item); a new baseline version (DBF-1.1) with its own files and lock is created by the baseline owner on approval
impact.NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE: a new prereg addendum declaring bz_family kind H1_REGISTERED (FE-DERIVED) with the files above is required before any Hall run uses them; the v1 prereg and addenda A1-A8 are not edited
